description: **Asset links, search and canonicals work on every page.** A page's stylesheet, search script, favicon and feed links were computed for the wrong directory depth on any versioned or localized page, so they resolved to files that were never written; search was unreachable and canonical, `og:url`, hreflang, breadcrumb, Atom feed and `llms.txt` URLs named pages that do not exist. Every emitted URL and output key now comes from one addressing authority, and a built site resolves correctly whether it is served from an origin root or under a path prefix.
